answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the forge check immediately, the anchor audit keeps the resolved set and the saffron replay publishes exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 246 aliases therefore pays the reading cost 246 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
